title: Janita is back again with an intriguing single that glows with seductive passion, “I Want You I Warn You”
htmlContent:
Janita is back with her new song, "I Want You I Warn You," which follows her hit "Real Deal." This enticing new track is the second single from her upcoming album, Mad Equation, which will be released in May.

While "Real Deal" was a huge success with nearly 250,000 streams and lots of praise, Janita raises the bar even higher with this new song. "I Want You I Warn You" is a slow and captivating listen, filled with rich beats and smooth vocals that create a thrilling yet slightly unsettling vibe.

https://open.spotify.com/album/4fgVqRAy8n99jZvBuvGcR2?si=PaUZpEDcQYyWDHgxekEE_Q

It showcases Janita's talent for blending tension and emotion beautifully. The song's impact remains, leaving you eager for more while also being aware of the risks involved. With her new album, Mad Equation, on the way, Janita again demonstrates why she's a significant artist in the music scene. This upcoming album could be a bold and powerful work of art.
